name: Dockerfile Starter
author: Talos Community
description: 1 local file templates for dockerfile starter.

templates.label: Multi-stage Dockerfile
templates.content:
FROM ${1:node:20-alpine} AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN ${2:npm ci && npm run build}

FROM ${3:node:20-alpine}
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
CMD [\"${4:node}\", \"dist/index.js\"]|.dockerignore
